第237章肉身重组，滴血重生，大道之光暴涨！
“没想到，我们天狱小队最终还是走到了这一步……”
本来，天狱小队一直在邪神战场外围做猎杀者，天狱又十分谨慎，不会遇到什么太大的危
早已调查清楚一切的李子明早已封锁了所有可能离开的方向，并布置了大量防守力量，谁也别妄想不接受检查带走任何东西。
辰星却没觉得它们有多嘈杂，因为他自己内心的烦躁已经掩盖过了这些外在的影响。
他们已经顾不上去想眼前的家伙是谁了，无论是谁也比面对着身后的那个恶魔要好一点。
已经因缘巧合知晓倾颜过往的紫葵忍住伤痛，突然地点住沈煜景的穴道，将自己所知道的关于倾颜的一切尽数传给沈煜景。
尽管冰蓝凌晞曾经告诉过她，她本先就是这个时空的人，但事到如今，她都还有些不相信。
加上叶天羽占据了天时地利人和，又是一举完全出乎叶风意料的突然使出最强悍的大招，控制住了叶风的举动。
丽蓝不由自主地在看棚内起身欢呼，只这一场，她和丽容手中的一千五百钱，便赢了一万五千钱，连本钱就有一万六千五了。
今天不论是在酒桌上说到的飞信，还是高峻对谢大的态度，都是她一时想不明白的。
“龙哥真是厉害，我越来越期待看到龙哥了。”苍鹰正是认为狼王传说终究只是夸大事实的传说之一，他觉得，自己才是真正得聪明人和牛逼人物，只不过运气不佳，没有官方人物牵头。

“你装的倒是挺像，之前我还真以为你和老五生疏陌路呢！”冷月拉着封柒夜置身自己身前的手，旋即回身柳眉一立，瞪着他怒中带俏，直让封柒夜在她脸颊上流连忘返。
在古代太无聊，有点消遣总是好的，她连忙点点头，就把弹弓收好，等回到王府就再玩。
“你别急，现在不能加入，不代表将来不能加入，你的天赋不错，又有特殊异能，只要勤于练习，能力还有很大的进步余地，到时候，你就可以踏入护龙一族，成为为守护华夏的一员！”杜均笑着说道。
木晚晴和霍寰始终是不同路的，就算再次回到京城又如何，她如今又有何所惧，她不能让雨绯的牺牲白费了。

折腾了一晚上，几人总算是回到了将军府。温子墨一改先前在宫中的鲁莽，直接回了自己的别院。白墨颜和沈云悠还有秋胜寒回到休息的地方，进了房间，疲惫的瘫倒在床，不想爬起来，甚至连衣服都懒得脱，就想要休息了。
“如果你不想死的话，倒是可以上去看看。”十方教的那个远古大神瞥了众妙门的这个高手，不屑的说道。
“呃！呵呵，青出于蓝，青出于蓝嘛！”沈敏娟微笑应着，沈子默的心被这无心的一句话剌的很疼，他只得低头微笑喝酒。
“哪里，只不过我自己之前也是主修灵魂修为的修仙者，所以灵魂修为才会稍微的高了一点而已！”李翰很谦虚道。
“一个可怜人罢了，得不到想要的东西，就来找我撒气。”沈云悠嘴角噙笑的和白墨颜说起，林玥以及夜子轩之间的事情，在听到白墨颜的轻笑声后，沈云悠也随之陷入了沉思。

Chapter 237: The physical body is reorganized, blood is reborn, and the light of the avenue surges!
"I didn't expect that our Heavenly Prison team would eventually reach this point..."
Originally, the Heavenly Prison team had been working as hunters outside the Evil God's battlefield, and the Heavenly Prison team was very cautious and would not encounter any major dangers.
Li Ziming, who has already investigated everything, has already blocked all possible directions of departure and deployed a large number of defensive forces. No one can even think of taking away anything without being inspected.
Chenxing didn't feel how noisy they were, because his own inner irritability had covered up these external influences.
They no longer cared about who the guy in front of them was. No matter who they were, it was better than facing the demon behind them.
Zikui, who had known Qingyan's past by chance, resisted the pain and suddenly touched Shen Yujing's acupuncture points, telling Shen Yujing everything she knew about Qingyan.
Although Binglan Lingxi once told her that she was originally from this time and space, she still doesn't believe it until now.
In addition, Ye Tianyu had the right time, place and people, and he suddenly used the most powerful ultimate move that was completely unexpected by Ye Feng, controlling Ye Feng's actions.
Li Lan couldn't help but stand up and cheer in the booth. In this one game, she and Li Rong won 15,000 yuan from the 1,500 yuan in their hands, and even their original capital was 16,500 yuan.
Today, whether it was the Fetion mentioned at the wine table or Gao Jun's attitude towards Xie Da, she couldn't understand it at the moment.
"Brother Long is really awesome. I'm looking forward to seeing him more and more." Cang Ying believes that the legend of the Wolf King is just one of the exaggerated legends. He feels that he is a truly smart and awesome person, but he is just unlucky and there is no official figure to take the lead.
Chapter 237: The physical body is reorganized, blood is reborn, and the light of the avenue surges!
"You pretend to be quite similar. I really thought you and Lao Wu were strangers before!" Leng Yue took Feng Qiye's hand in front of her, then turned around and raised her eyebrows, glaring at him with anger and beauty, making Feng Qiye linger on her cheek.
It was too boring in ancient times, and it was always good to have some entertainment. She nodded quickly, put the slingshot away, and would play again when she returned to the palace.
"Don't worry, just because you can't join now doesn't mean you can't join in the future. You have good talents and special abilities. As long as you practice diligently, there is still a lot of room for improvement in your abilities. When the time comes, you can step into the Guardian Dragon Clan and become a member of the Guardian China!" Du Jun said with a smile.
Mu Wanqing and Huo Huan have always been on different paths. So what if they return to the capital again? What does she have to fear now? She cannot let Yu Fei's sacrifice be in vain.
After struggling all night, they finally returned to the general's mansion. Wen Zimo changed his previous recklessness in the palace and returned directly to his villa. Bai Moyan, Shen Yunyou and Qiu Shenghan returned to the resting place, entered the room, and collapsed on the bed exhausted, not wanting to get up, not even bothering to take off their clothes, just wanting to rest.
"If you don't want to die, you can go up and have a look." The ancient great god from Shifang Sect glanced at the master of Zhongmiao Sect and said disdainfully.
"Uh! Haha, what is better than what is better than what is better than what is better!" Shen Minjuan responded with a smile. Shen Zimo's heart was hurt by this unintentional sentence, and he had to lower his head and drink with a smile.
"No, it's just that I was also a cultivator who majored in soul cultivation before, so my soul cultivation is a little higher!" Li Han said very modestly.
"oneHe's just a poor man. He came to me to vent his anger when he couldn't get what he wanted. "Chen Yunyou talked to Bai Moyan with a smile on his face about what happened between Lin Yue and Ye Zixuan. After hearing Bai Moyan's chuckle, Shen Yunyou also fell into deep thought.
